_comment: Ignite Master – Pterodactyl Egg. Installiert den Rust-Master aus dem neuesten GitHub Release.
name: Ignite Master
author: team@ignite-network
description: Zentraler Rust-Master für das Ignite Minecraft-Netzwerk. Empfängt Backups von Servern, steuert Pterodactyl, managed nahtlose Server-Wechsel inkl. Proxy.

installation.script:
# ============================================================
# Ignite Master – Installations-Skript
# Holt den neuesten Release von GitHub oder baut aus dem Source.
# ============================================================

set -euo pipefail

GITHUB_REPO="{{env.GITHUB_REPO}}"
RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/latest"

ARCH="$(uname -m)"
case "${ARCH}" in
    x86_64)  TARGET="x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu" ;;
    aarch64) TARGET="aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu" ;;
    armv7l)  TARGET="armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf" ;;
    *)
        echo "[!] Unbekannte Architektur: ${ARCH}, baue aus Source..."
        BUILD_FROM_SOURCE=1
        ;;
esac

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# --------------------------------------------------
# Versuche, ein Prebuilt-Binary aus dem Release zu laden
# --------------------------------------------------
if [ -z "${BUILD_FROM_SOURCE:-}" ]; then
    echo "[+] Architektur: ${ARCH} → Target: ${TARGET}"
    echo "[+] Lade Release-Info von ${RELEASE_URL} ..."

    RELEASE_JSON=$(curl -sfL "${RELEASE_URL}" || echo "")

    if [ -n "${RELEASE_JSON}" ]; then
        BINARY_URL=$(echo "${RELEASE_JSON}" | \
            python3 -c "import sys,json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); \
            assets=data.get('assets',[]); \
            matches=[a for a in assets if '${TARGET}' in a['name'] or '${TARGET}' in a['browser_download_url']]; \
            print(matches[0]['browser_download_url'] if matches else '')" 2>/dev/null || echo "")

        if [ -n "${BINARY_URL}" ]; then
            echo "[+] Lade Binary herunter: ${BINARY_URL}"
            curl -sfL "${BINARY_URL}" -o ignite-master.tar.gz
            tar xzf ignite-master.tar.gz
            chmod +x ignite-master
            echo "[+] Binary erfolgreich installiert."
            exit 0
        fi
    fi
fi

# --------------------------------------------------
# Fallback: Aus Source bauen
# --------------------------------------------------
echo "[+] Kein passendes Release-Binary gefunden, baue aus Source..."

echo "[+] Installiere Rust via rustup..."
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y
source "$HOME/.cargo/env"
rustup default stable

echo "[+] Klone Repository: ${GITHUB_REPO}"
rm -rf ignite-source
git clone --depth 1 "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}.git" ignite-source
cd ignite-source/master

echo "[+] Baue Master (Release)..."
cargo build --release

echo "[+] Kopiere Binary..."
cp target/release/ignite-master /mnt/server/
cp /mnt/server/ignite-source/ignite-config.example.toml /mnt/server/ || true
chmod +x /mnt/server/ignite-master

echo "[+] Build abgeschlossen."
